faq_heading: College Park houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in College Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

College Park, Port Moody: 11 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 6 of 11 Port Moody communities for houses.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in College Park fell from 12 in June to 11 in October (−8.3%), and 10 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 8.0% of Port Moody’s 138 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in College Park?
College Park also had 14 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in October, against 11 houses listed. The College Park condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: College Park Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: The City's Port Moody 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), Chapter 14, groups College Park with Harbour Heights, Glenayre and Seaview as one neighbourhood plan section.

blocks.text: College Park Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses on the Clarke Road and College Park Way side of the city's west end, under the RS zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 2937.

The College Park Elementary building stands at 300 Princeton Avenue, but the building does not appear in School District No. 43's current Port Moody school list, so its status is not verified and no catchment should be assumed from the building.

blocks.text: College Park Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) is permitted in the RS and RT zones outside the City's transit-oriented areas, which is the densification route that does apply here.
Port Moody is inside the speculation and vacancy tax taxable area, so residential owners here must declare each year.

blocks.text: College Park Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: College Park is the closest Port Moody neighbourhood to the Burnaby border on the Barnet Highway (Highway 7A) and St. Johns Street route, so its west edge is a municipal boundary, not just a street.

The City plans College Park together with Harbour Heights, Glenayre and Seaview in one Chapter 14 section, so Official Community Plan reading for this pocket is a four-neighbourhood section, not a College Park chapter.
Seaview's stated extent — College Park Way to Ingersoll Street, Seaforth Way to Glenayre Drive — is the closest thing to a boundary the City publishes for this cluster.

blocks.text: College Park Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Port Moody property taxes are set city-wide, and the speculation and vacancy tax applies in Port Moody, so owners declare annually.
Barnet Highway (Highway 7A) and St. Johns Street run east–west through the city, and Clarke Road serves the College Park and Glenayre side streets.
Glenayre Drive ties the pocket to Glenayre and the Glenayre Centre at 492 Glencoe Drive.

blocks.text: College Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 houses sold in College Park with a median price of $1,640,850 (the middle half sold between $1,353,750 and $1,858,750), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 19% sold above list. They had a median $600 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 7,594 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in College Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in College Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is College Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in College Park had a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in College Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in College Park over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in College Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What is the Suncor lands issue beside College Park?
faq.a: The Suncor refinery lands beside College Park and Seaview are an Official Community Plan Special Study Area, which makes them the main planning item over this end of the city: any change there runs through a special study rather than a routine application, and buyers should read the study-area status before relying on the lands staying as they are.

faq.q: Is there a school in College Park?
faq.a: A school building stands at 300 Princeton Avenue, but it does not appear in School District No. 43's current Port Moody school list, so its status is not verified — confirm the catchment schools for the exact address with SD43 rather than assuming the building assigns them.

faq.q: Where is the nearest recreation centre?
faq.a: The Glenayre Centre, at 492 Glencoe Drive, is the recreation facility in adjoining Glenayre, and École Glenayre Elementary stands at 495 Glencoe Drive beside it.

faq.q: What did houses in College Park sell for?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in College Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,640,850.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in College Park?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (19% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
